scope: Review independent read-only numerical and multi-view acceptance of one rectangular prism.

checks.name: single_purpose
checks.notes: The operation accepts or rejects one rectangular-prism artifact against its geometry contract.

checks.name: read_only

checks.name: separate_layers
checks.notes: Measurements, native save, native reopen, and visual agreement remain independent results.

checks.name: evidence_boundary

notes: No runtime, persistence, or visual acceptance is claimed for the new artifact.
